messages:
pagerduty-bot: Pager: URGENT — elevated 5xx observed on api-gateway-eu (502/504 spike). Trigger=error_rate>15% over 5m. Paging oncall: @alex, @maria. Incident channel created.

alex: ack, i'll take first pass. oncall now. grabbing edge metrics + ingress logs.

maria: i'm available for escalation. alex, if it's traffic fanout we may need routing fallback.

alex: quick snapshot — requests/sec normal, error rate concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat, error codes 502 & 504 mainly from edge->gateway hop.

ryan: tagging in (eng-gateway). any recent config pushes to the gateway fleets?

alex: not that I see in deploy history for eu region. last deploy was 4h ago.

opsbot: deploy-bot: No active deploys to api-gateway-eu in the last 6 hours.

alex: dumping a few logs, past 2 minutes:
```
[17:21:02] edge-12 -> gateway-3 HTTP/1.1 502 0.142s "POST /v1/generate"
[17:21:03] edge-18 -> gateway-7 HTTP/1.1 504 30.001s "POST /v1/chat"
[17:21:04] edge-09 -> gateway-3 HTTP/1.1 502 0.118s "POST /v1/generate"
```

alex: noticing increased backend timeouts (~>28s) before 504. some 502s are immediate connection resets.

ryan: can you curl the gateway health endpoints from edge nodes? suspecting backend LB health flapping or slow model backend.

alex: running quick checks, from edge-18: `curl -s -D - https://gateway-eu.internal/healthz -o /dev/null` -> all nodes report 200/OK, but a few backend pool members show high latency in /metrics.

maria: what's the customer impact surface? any error spikes correlated with large customers?

eve: support: we already have two P1s opened by customers in EU complaining about timeouts in product flows. ETA unknown. I'm collecting affected customer IDs.

ryan: i'm going to pull LB stats. if backend instances are accepting connections but not responding, could be saturation or slow GC in model VMs.

alex: mitigation suggestions — 1) temporarily enable regional fallback to us-west for non-data-residency tenants, 2) increase gateway timeout threshold so short backend GC pauses don't surface as 504s, 3) circuit-break high-latency backend nodes. thoughts?

julia: product: fallback is ok for a subset of traffic, want to avoid moving EU-only tenants. prefer targeted fallback by customer tier.

maria: agree. do quick experiments: identify noisy backend pools, circuit-break them, then monitor. we can open a controlled fallback for best-effort tenants.

alex: executing step 1 — identify top 5 backend pools by 95p latency.

alex: results: pool-g-3 and pool-g-7 showing 95p=28-35s, connection resets to pool-g-3. others normal.

ryan: i'm pushing a soft-drain on pool-g-3 and pool-g-7. command: `kubectl -n gateway annotate deploy gateway-pool-g-3 maintenance=true --overwrite` then scale down by 1 to shift traffic for immediate relief.

alex: applying drain now.

opsbot: Routing change applied: soft-drain annotated for gateway-pool-g-3, gateway-pool-g-7.

alex: seeing immediate drop in 504s from edge-12 & edge-09. error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in 90s.

maria: good. keep an eye on latency tail on remaining pools. also schedule a rollback if errors climb.

ryan: digging into pool-g-3 instances — recent memory growth pattern, one instance showing repeated full GC logs. likely a model runtime OOM/GC thrash. capturing JVM/worker dump and opening followup on infra board.

alex: creating short customer comms draft (eve pls review):
"We experienced elevated 5xx errors in EU (17:20–17:35 UTC) affecting inference requests. Mitigation applied, traffic rerouted; some requests experienced increased latency or were retried. Engineers are investigating root cause."

eve: noted — i'll post with timestamp and advise support to use temporary retries guidance. :thumbsup:

julia: does this need an immediate SE/AE outreach for large customers?

eve: one enterprise affected — recommending an outreach. collecting contact.

alex: next steps:
- ryan to open infra ticket with worker heap + GC dumps (assigned)
- maria to monitor for 15m and validate error rate stability
- alex to coordinate customer comms and handoff to postmortem leads

ryan: ticket created: INFRA-4872 with heap dumps attached. preliminary hypothesis: model runtime memory leak or long GC cycles causing request timeouts.

maria: monitoring: error rate holding ~5-7%, no increasing trend for past 6 mins. continuing to watch.

alex: switching to incident-warm mode, handing off to maria for ongoing watch. i'll stay available if escalations pop up.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by on-call: maria. Follow-up escalation scheduled in 15m if error_rate > 8%.

maria: thanks — team, if error rate climbs again, plan is to re-enable broader fallback and potentially spin extra gateway capacity in eu region.

ryan: follow-up action items logged:
- INFRA-4872 investigate and patch model runtime memory
- GATEWAY-2394 add circuit-break auto-trigger for high 95p latency
- OPS-1216 run chaos test on routing fallback to validate failover procedure

alex: adding note: avoid blanket timeout increases — prefer targeted circuit-break and gradual retries to prevent retry storms.

eve: sending customer note now. posting incident summary to status page draft.

julia: thanks all. nice fast triage.

maria: closing active handoff. i'll post a postmortem link once we have root cause.

opsbot: Incident channel archived by automation after 30m of inactivity.
